tier_note: NOT HUMAN_VALIDATED. CTO is not independent (per MC-1). This tier can check whether the machine scorer agrees with informed CTO judgment; it CANNOT validate the system.

observable_judgment.description: Evaluated from the BLINDED packet only. The adjudicator judges plausibility and structure — NOT ground truth.

ground_truth_evaluation.description: Evaluated ONLY AFTER unblinding, by the comparison engine, against frozen labels. The adjudicator does NOT answer these.

Q1_MECHANISTIC_VALIDITY.question: Is the proposed mechanism scientifically valid and plausibly tied to the exposed facts?

Q2_DISCOVERY_STRUCTURE_VALIDITY.question: Does the proposed_relationship express a relationship NOT explicit in the exposed_facts that combines them in a novel way?

Q3_NOVELTY.question: Does the proposal introduce genuinely new entities, mechanisms, or relational structure beyond the exposed_facts?

Q4_FALSIFIABILITY.question: Is the proposed_relationship specific enough to be falsifiable?

Q5_EXPERIMENTAL_COHERENCE.question: Could an experiment be designed to test this proposal, given the exposed_facts?

Q6_PLAUSIBILITY.question: Is this proposal scientifically plausible — could it work in reality, regardless of whether it has been historically demonstrated?
Q6_PLAUSIBILITY.note: This replaces V1's Q6_REAL_VS_FABRICATED. The adjudicator judges PLAUSIBILITY (observable from the packet), NOT ground-truth REAL/FABRICATED (which is hidden). The comparison engine checks whether PLAUSIBILITY correlates with the actual label after unblinding.
